Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator [[Dennis DeConcini]] decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. Republican nominee [[Jon Kyl]] won the open seat, becoming the first Republican to win Arizona's Class 1 Senate seat since [[Paul Fannin]] in [[1970 United States Senate election in Arizona|1970]]. Democrats would not win this seat again, or any Senate race in the state, until [[Kyrsten Sinema]]'s victory in [[2018 United States Senate election in Arizona|2018]]. == Democratic primary == === Candidates === * [[Sam Coppersmith]], U.S. Representative * [[Richard D.
